text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Such mastery and precision at such a young age.
Are you truly a rookie Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well now, I can't afford to fall behind either.
You've shown me something great, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Well, or perhaps it's simply the reckless result of youthful enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Regardless of the details, you climbed all the way to the top! Splendid, splendid! Ahaha!
